Hymn 1: The Morning Breaks
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: George Careless
Lyricist/Text Author: Parley P. Pratt
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 1 titled "The Morning Breaks" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George Careless and the lyrics were written by Parley P. Pratt.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
